notes.title: How the intro was HAND made!
notes.content:
That’s right! This week I wanted to share with you some behind the scenes of how the animated intro was HANDled from inception to completion by the fantastic folks at Brikk! The original idea came about when thinking ‘why’. Why is the hand armless and what is its motivation. I quickly realised that getting the arm back was a priority and so this meant I had an idea for the intro.



https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42445631/3aded773918744c677ad8c4059c23e32f417c8f1.png

Above you can see my original story board that I wanted to share with potential partners who could help me make it a reality. I did consider if it could be done in-game/engine but quickly realised this needed to be something very special and to do it in-game would take too much of my time that I wanted to devote to making a fantastic game experience.



https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42445631/41222ffd6b580d25676fc5ce04d59ccec9ebeb41.png

I was introduced to Brikk and we had a great conversation about what I envisaged and they loved the idea. Here is work in progress as they blocked out the intro from my original story board. What also liked with working with Brikk was their ideas of injecting the same sort of humor that I wanted in Super Adventure Hand.




[previewyoutube=7AVEaX-nHe8;full][/previewyoutube]
And as you can see they really did a fantastic job and I HANDS down love it! I hope you enjoyed this little bit of behind the scenes information and I will think of some more things to share over the summer. If you haven’t seen the intro, why don’t you give the latest version of the demo a whirl and check it out there!



Until next week. Stay HANDsome! ✋

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42445631/e4f5dbac826b373c67cbb6ae0a91e890142b193f.gif

notes.title: Development update - Guerrilla Collective
notes.content:
Continuing on my plan to do more regular updates here is this weeks and it’s an exciting one. 
I’ve been busy working on my levels, tweaking old ones and optimizing Super Adventure Hand further.

The exciting part is that late on Wednesday / Thursday (depending on where you are) I will be releasing a new updated demo. This will have lots of new tweaks, fixes, squashed bugs and a brand new level to play! 
There is also one other addition but I won’t spoil the surprise, you’ll just have to check it out and let me know what you think!

Super Adventure Hand will also make an appearance at the Guerrilla Collective so tune into the stream to check it out on Wednesday!

notes.title: Development update
notes.content:
I’m going to try and do more regular updates on things I’ve been working on so here goes!
This last week I spent a large chunk of time creating some new levels. I managed to make 5 more which have all come together nicely. They offer various different challenges and I promise I’ve not been too devious!

To tease you a little I can reveal that in these levels there is more fire, pipes, keys (of course) some little ones and plenty of opportunities to use your brains (well hand brains). I’ve also found an opportunity to reuse some other aspects of some previous levels in new and interesting ways.
There is some exciting stuff coming which I can’t say much about yet but be prepared to see some new things in early June!
